# Where Lóngwáng works now: the myths behind the markets

The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Lóngwáng** works now.

The Dragon Kings stand at the crossing of two Chinas: the literary China of the great Ming novels, where they are foils, creditors, and comic bureaucrats, and the living China of the village temple, where they were the address to which a drought-stricken county sent its prayers. The same figure is mocked in the novel and begged in the field.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Lóngwáng
- **Pantheon:** Chinese
- **Domain of influence:** Dragons, Rain, Rivers
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World
- **Strongest seat:** Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 279 of 542

## The Myth at Work

**The Jìng River Dragon King's Wager.** The Journey to the West preserves the great cautionary tale of the celestial bureaucracy.  The Dragon King of the Jìng River wagers with a mortal fortune-teller over the next day's rain; when the Jade Emperor's decree arrives matching the diviner's figures exactly, the king — unwilling to lose — secretly alters the amount and delays the timing. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**Nézhā and the Third Prince.** In the Investiture of the Gods (Féngshén Yǎnyì), the boy Nézhā, bathing in the eastern stream, shakes the East Sea crystal palace to its foundations with his magic sash.  Āo Guǎng sends his third son, Āo Bǐng, to subdue the child; Nézhā kills the prince and plucks out his sinews to make a belt. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.

## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Maritime, Shipping & Ocean Industries

*Shipping, ports, fishing, and ocean exploration. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*The four seas are his family's jurisdiction; every hull in Chinese waters sailed under the Dragon Kings' toll.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Freshwater & Hydrology

*Water supply, irrigation, and watershed management. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*Rain, rivers, and wells are the office — drought-stricken counties petitioned his temple as the water ministry of last resort.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Agriculture, Food & Harvest

*Farming, grain, food production, and agtech. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The rain-prayer was farming China's oldest agtech; his temple stood where the irrigation district now sits.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Meteorology & Weather Intelligence

*Forecasting, storm tracking, and climate analytics. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Rain decrees are his paperwork — the Journey to the West's Jìng River king was executed for falsifying one forecast.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

## The Long Employment

The Dragon King never fully retired.  His temples still stand along China's coasts and rivers, and rain-processions to the local king persisted in the countryside into the twentieth century. The age changed. The work did not.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity’s documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in maritime, shipping & ocean industries, freshwater & hydrology, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/longwang/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
